purpose: Represent an explicit caller/agent selection of one currently available runtime-evidence response candidate without executing it or mutating Resolution state.

creation.source: interpret_recorded_evidence over a recorded exact-subject ResolutionEvidenceInbox entry
requires: selected response candidate is currently available in the evidence interpretation projection
exact evidence fingerprint is captured at selection time
creation.unavailable_candidate: fails closed; independent review/revision escape hatches remain available outside this evidence-derived intent path

identity.response_intent_fingerprint: fnv1a64 over selector + evidence fingerprint + selected action + target boundary + handoff + entry index
identity.fingerprint_security: deterministic correlation only; not a cryptographic signature

checks: selected action is still available from the current interpretation projection
candidate target boundary/handoff still match the intent snapshot
preflight.ready: means the intent remains structurally admissible for a future execution adapter; it does not authorize or execute anything

invariants: selection is explicit caller/agent input rather than interpreter choice
an unavailable evidence-derived candidate cannot be encoded as ResponseIntent
independent Resolution review/revision APIs remain escape hatches outside this evidence-derived path
preflight only validates current correspondence and does not execute the intent
